value.title: I'll Protect Grace
value.synopsis: The sentiment is expressed by protagonist Taro, who vows to protect the two personalities, and is also embodied by Grace, who originally came into existence to protect Cynthia.

value.title: Anticipation for Konoe
value.synopsis: Konoe, known for her severe personality, takes it upon herself to help Taro become a more proper and responsible master of the mansion.

value.title: I'll give you experience
value.synopsis: Ikuyo tricking or duping Taro into spending a day disguised as a maid.
